text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"More controlled paragraphing with topic sentences like 'Initially,' 'Secondly,' and 'However,'","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures how clearly the essay structures its argument into recognizable sections and signal transitions."},{"evidence":"Longer, layered sentences such as 'With limitations in place, like blocking certain apps and websites that have nothing to do with school, cellphones could be…'","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"This captures the ability to build more extended and varied sentence structures."},{"evidence":"Uses qualifying phrasing and concession: 'On the other hand,' 'However, it could be helpful and very easy to set up'","quality":"nuanced development","description":"This captures how the essay acknowledges counterarguments and develops a more balanced argument."},{"evidence":"Specific causal chains like 'daily grades get better, but when test day arrives…'","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"This captures clearer explanation of consequences rather than simple assertions."},{"evidence":"More precise academic vocabulary: 'technological integration,' 'educational time,' 'viable'","quality":"word choice precision","description":"This captures more controlled and topic-appropriate vocabulary selection."},{"evidence":"Fewer disruptive errors such as 'loose focus,' 'student's attention,' and 'too much of teenager's attention'","quality":"language control","description":"This captures stronger command of grammar, agreement, and spelling at the sentence level."}]}
